This '''armband''' was discovered to have had the words, "For M Vao. - Z", coarsely engraved upon it. Upon further investigation, the item appeared to have had the ability to augment the wearer's [[nervous system]], resulting in a greater degree of dexterous movement. It is believed that the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] may have acquired this article sometime during her travels in [[3951 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
This armband appears in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' and is alluded to be a gift to [[Mission Vao]] by her best friend the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Zaalbar]], characters featured in the original ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', and it is unclear if [[Obsidian Entertainment]], the developers of ''The Sith Lords'', attached any particular significance to this item. This item can only be obtained using cheats.
